identification.source: Sprengel 1830, vol. 2, p. 636 (Comm. IV cap. CLII, σίκυς ἄγριος): 'Est vero Momordica Elaterium, in Graecia satis vulgaris planta, cuius succus amarissimus et hodie purgante vi insignis celebratur'; describes the explosive fruit. Momordica elaterium L. = Ecballium elaterium (synonymy ours). | Fraas 1845, p. 102: '1. Ecbalium Elaterium Rich., Springgurke' = ὁ ἄγριος σίκυος Theophr. 9,15, σίκυς ἄγριος Diosc. 4,152, source of Elaterium; modern ἀγριαγγουριά; very common on poor fields of the lowlands (Attica). Osbaldeston 2000, ch. 4-154 SIKUS AGRIOS: SUGGESTED ... Ecballium elaterium, Momordica elaterium [Linnaeus]. (https://archive.org/details/BIUSante_dioscsprengelx02/page/n637/mode/1up ; https://archive.org/details/synopsisplantaru00fraa/page/n147/mode/1up)
